Boon.description: Rules 0.9.0: a boon on one of your demigods.

Curse.description: Rules 0.9.0: a seal or curse. The public face is the mark on its target; `owner`, `owner_name`, `yours`, `on_you`, `paid_sparks` and `quest` are only for the bearer's and the owner's seats.

counter.description: Always "a mystic quest": every curse has one.

does.description: What it does, in plain words.

god.description: The god whose god-tier variant it is.

kind.description: seal: no resurrection; wither: no healing; silence: wills cost double; bind: can't be summoned; hex: minus its strength on d20s.

on_you.description: It lies on one of your demigods.

strength.description: 1 weak .. 3 god-tier: its counter-quest's length, a hex's bite.

until_beat.description: The last beat it holds; null = until countered.

DmEvent.description: Rules 0.8.0: one public decision of the DM this beat: `event` (settlement.grew, settlement.shrank, settlement.building, encounter.marked, encounter.revealed, encounter.faded, loot.dropped, loot.taken, road.formed, road.faded, shrine.built, shrine.level, story.scar, story.wardrobe, story.followers, time.phase), `text` (one line), `memory` (its memory entry id) and the decision's own fields (docs/CLIENT_API.md).

Entity.description: One thing a seat can see (`world::entity_json`): a ref, its display name and kind, plus a few kind-specific fields. Rivals' health is never included.

action.description: Mobs only: what it is doing (gathering, rioting, looting, attacking, marching, dispersed).

army_of.description: Clusters that are armies only: the demigod (`dg:<n>`) it marches for.

cell_kind.description: Cells only: gang, squad, congregation, crew or militia.

kind.description: Matches the ref prefix (dg, ch, cl, gr, gd, pl, it, ag, lg, ce, mb).

pos.description: Where it is, when it has a position (absent for groups, gods, agents).

rank.description: Characters with a society sheet only.

role.description: Characters with a society sheet only.

FavorLine.description: A god's favor toward one demigod.

favor.description: That god's favor toward you (about -10..10; it shifts its rulings).

HandLine.description: One hand in `round.private`: what it said back this beat and its live subagents.

said.description: The hand's one spoken line back to you this beat (empty when you said nothing to it).

subagents.description: Live subagents and possessions under this hand (same objects as seat_view.hands[].subagents).

ImageObject.description: An image the media server attached (only when the server has images on; see docs/MEDIA.md). Fetch `url` once `status` is `ready` (watch GET /media/index for `hash`); `off` = none will come, show a placeholder.

hash.description: Content key (sha256 hex): cache by it forever.

prompt.description: The full prompt sent to the image model (house style; no engine ids).

url.description: `/media/<hash>.<ext>` once ready, relative to the server's HTTP origin.

Item.description: Rules 0.7.0: an item (a manifested thing, or one an older path made).

art.description: State schema 11: the item picture's key (sha256 of its normalized descriptor: kind, material, tier, name stem, blessing): the same key is the same picture in every match.

blessed_by.description: Rules 0.9.0: the god whose blessing it carries (a tier up, and that god's signature).

count.description: Soldiers, vessels, creatures or copies (rounded; f64 range: 100,000,000 is fine).

does.description: Rules 0.9.0: one line saying what it does ("+2 to strikes, +0.5 damage, +1 in duels; Smite: ...").

history.description: Custody: {beat, state, holder?, by?, row?, count?}.

image_prompt.description: The item image subject (`image_kind` item). State schema 11: only an item granted a picture has it (a notable item a human player's demigod holds or that lies in a loot pile, within item_art_per_match); every other item shows its `icon`.

manifestation.description: `mf:<n>`, the attempt that made it (`game.item`: the Manifestation object itself).

material.description: Rules 0.9.0: what it is made of (the damage type its armour resists; some add to journeys).

rows.description: game.item only: the attempt's ledger rows.

slot.description: Rules 0.9.0: the slot this gear fills (a demigod fights with its best item per slot).

ItemMods.description: Rules 0.9.0: what a piece of gear adds (zeroes are left out). Totals are capped per demigod: +3 on a d20, +1.5 damage, 1.5 guard, 0.4 regen, +3 in duels.

damage.description: Damage added to each strike it lands on another body.

deed.description: d20 modifier on its other deeds (parleys, makings, its own wills).

duel.description: Added to its duel blows' d20 (challenge mode's gear term).

guard.description: Damage turned aside from each hit it takes (never more than half the hit).

regen.description: Health regained each beat, below its maximum.

resist.description: A damage type halved: fire, storm, curse, lightning, cold, water, poison, blade or fall.

strike.description: d20 modifier on its bearer's strikes (attacks and threats).

thorns.description: Damage a demigod takes for striking its bearer.

ItemPower.description: Rules 0.9.0: a once-per-match power (relic tier and up, or Death's blessing).

LonLat.description: [longitude, latitude] in degrees (WGS84). Note the order: longitude first.

Manifestation.description: Rules 0.7.0: one manifestation attempt (made or not).

art.description: State schema 11: the made item's picture key (with image_prompt).

image_prompt.description: State schema 11: absent when the item has no picture of its own yet (gear looks on).

request.description: Your own only: kind, count, magnitude.

verdict.description: Your own only: outcome, tier, odds {success, twist, partial, backfire, terms}, roll, cost {required, bolts, extra, missing, debt}, god, favor, entropy, reasons, flavor.

at.description: Where it happened, [lon, lat] (null only for bookkeeping with no place).

how.description: How you know: "you did it", "it happened to you", "you saw it", "you were told", "your followers heard" or "rumor".

refs.description: The actor, then the targets (refs to link in the UI), each at most once.

region.description: The region (planet) or district (city) it happened in.

row.description: The ledger row's ref (`lg:<n>`). Never repeated within one payload.

Omen.description: A god's ruling as a client sees it (public omens and your own invocations).

god_ref.description: The god's ref (`gd:<n>`; the table is in round.brief.public.gods).

speech.description: What the god said. Never starts with the god's name (render `god` yourself).

Quest.description: Rules 0.9.0: a mystic quest: a short chain of checkable steps; when all are done its effect applies.

expires_beat.description: The last beat it may be finished on (null: it stays).

goal.description: What finishing it does: {kind: heal, amount} | {kind: boon, bonus, beats} | {kind: temper, item, intent, tier} | {kind: arm, slot, tier, name, god} | {kind: break_curse, curse, curse_kind} | {kind: raise, years}.

god.description: The god whose ruling it is.

helpers.description: Other seats who took it up (a plea for someone else's fallen demigod).

public.description: Everyone sees it (a raising, a seal's counter); else only its seat and the curse's owner.

seat.description: Whose quest it is (their standing demigods do the steps).

text.description: The DM's telling, Rube Goldberg style.

waiting.description: Every step is done but something holds the effect back (a seal on the one to be raised).

QuestStep.description: Rules 0.9.0: one checkable requirement of a mystic quest. `kind` says which, with its own fields: at {place: shrine {of} | settlement {level} | fault | coast | point {at, name}, phase?, offer?}, hold {word}, encounter, shrine, duel, sparks {n}, army {at, name, general}, vigil {phase, times, seen}.

near.description: at: a place that satisfied the step when the quest was given (the nearest shrine or settlement of the kind, the remembered spot): where to send the demigod. Any place of the kind will do. Absent for fault lines and coasts.

offer.description: at: an item whose name carries this word must be in hand there; it is burned.

progress.description: Why it is not done yet, as of the last check (absent when done or never checked).

step.description: Its number in the chain (steps are done in order).

word.description: hold: the word the item's name must carry.

Raises.description: Rules 0.9.0: raisings Death granted you this match, of the cap.

of.description: The node or unit they hold rank in.

Ref.description: A pointer to any row of the world: dg demigod, ch character, cl cluster, gr group, gd god, pl place, it item, ag agent, lg ledger row, ce cell, mb mob. Stable for the whole match.

Role.description: A person's part in the society.

SubagentKind.description: What kind of agent a subagent line is: a subagent, a possession (steers a body) or a paladin (a god's champion).

SubagentLine.description: A live subagent, possession or paladin, in every payload that lists one.

beats_left.description: Beats until it expires; null = no budget (possessions last until recalled).

body.description: The person it steers (`ch:<n>`) for possessions and paladins, else null.

line.description: What it said this beat (round.private), else its goal.

name.description: Display name; a possession reads "<person> (steered by <you>)".

parent.description: The agent that spawned it (`ag:<n>`, your hand for subagents and possessions), or null.

Will.description: Rules 0.9.0: what became of one will (one text box of yours this beat, or a fallen player's plea): split into its parts, each resolved on its own. Rules 0.8.1 states send only {text, routed_to, verdict, speech, reason}.

by_name.description: The demigod whose hand heard it.

gods.description: Every god that ruled, in order.

routed_to.description: The first god that ruled (Nature for heals, Death for raisings, the gear's patron...).

verdict.description: 0.9.0: granted (every part as willed), partial (something fell short: see the parts) or refused. 0.8.1: the god's verdict.

WillPaid.description: Rules 0.9.0: what a will part's price came to.

bolts_broken.description: Bolts broken into sparks for it (the change stays in the purse).

debt.description: Debt the ruling god lent for the shortfall (0 = none).

short_sparks.description: Sparks of the price the purse did not pay.

WillPart.description: Rules 0.9.0: one part of a will for one target, with its own ruling. Always `part`, `outcome` and `result`; a roll, a price, the reason and the way forward when they apply. Extra fields by part: heal {healed, boon?}, arm {asked_tier, blessed, item}, raise {price {sparks, years, fallen_beat, raised_before}, curse?}, curse {curse, curse_ref, counter}, ask {quests[], curses[]}.

god.description: The god that ruled this part.

next.description: When it fell short: what would work (the quest's steps, or the price).

outcome.description: crit / success: as willed; partial: a token now and a quest for the rest (or gear a tier low); fizzle: a natural 1, a quest; quest: nothing could be paid, a quest; blocked: a curse forbids it; sealed: a seal forbids the raising; refused / unpaid: not done, with why; raised; cast / backfired: a curse landed (on its caster); told; offered; gathered.

result.description: What happened, in plain words ("healed Chris's Left Hand 2.5", "forged a Gold Rocket Launcher (trinket): +1 to strikes").

WillRoll.description: Rules 0.9.0: a will part's d20, with every modifier named.

mods.description: The modifiers that made `modifier` (zeroes left out).

name.description: wardrobe, charm, boon, hexed, <God>'s favor, paid in full, on credit, part paid, the Final Wish, the caster, <God>'s hand.

bolts.description: Lightning bolts you hold (the god-energy unit: casts and god invocations cost them).

debt_open.description: Sum of your open debts (damage points).

echo_charges.description: Charges left for the echo (duplicate an item) base power.

favor.description: Every god's favor toward you, in god order (gd:0 .. gd:6).

followers.description: Head count of your Following group.

health.description: Current health (0 to max_health, Final Night's 0-10 scale).

sparks.description: Rules 0.7.0: sparks you hold (the mini-power currency).

oneOf.description: A district (on the planet: a region).
One city (on the planet; in a city arena, a site).

description: `round.private.private` (the `SeatDelta`): what only your seat learns from the beat that just resolved. Sent to every human seat, spectators included.

beat.description: The beat that just resolved (= the Theatre round).

curses.description: Rules 0.9.0: curses holding now (or broken in the last 8 beats): the ones on your demigods and the ones you cast in full, the others' public faces.

demigods.description: Rules 0.7.0: both of your demigods (`you` is your lead one: the first standing).

items.description: Rules 0.7.0: one of your two demigods this beat.

curses.description: Rules 0.9.0: the curses holding on it.

items.description: Rules 0.9.0: what it holds now (gear with its mods).

focus.description: What you are focused on, as an Entity object (same shape as seat_view.focus), or null.

hands.description: Your two hands (index 0 = left, 1 = right): what each said back this beat and its live subagents.

hierarchy.description:
The hierarchy at your zoom (schema 4): the node in view with its path, children, crowds and cells, people,
armies with their chains of command, mobs and recent battles. Shape: `docs/CLIENT_API.md` ("Hierarchy").

manifests.description: Rules 0.7.0: your demigods' manifestations this beat, with the verdict.

news.description: Ledger rows new this beat that you know about, newest first, at most one line per row.

omens.description: This beat's rulings you may see: the public ones plus your own invocations, even small ones.

quests.description: Rules 0.9.0: your mystic quests, the public ones and the counters of curses you cast (open, or closed in the last 8 beats), steps with done flags.

will_events.description: Rules 0.9.0: this beat's quest and curse events only your seat gets (quest.given, quest.step, quest.done, quest.failed of private quests): the same shapes as the public dm_events.

wills.description: Rules 0.9.0: every will of yours this beat, split into its parts, each with its roll, price, result and (when it fell short) why and what would work. Rules 0.8.1: only a fallen player's wills. Absent when you willed nothing.

zoom.description: Your zoom level after this beat's view changes.

title: round.private private (SeatDelta)
